openingMessage: Be more concerned with your character than your reputation, because your character is what you really are, while your reputation is merely what others think you are.
openingWhy: Your reputation is what the audit sees. Your character is what the wellhead sees at 3 AM with no company man in fifty miles. Out here, the gas only ever meets your character.
leadershipThought: We protect lives on location. We represent our clients — Exxon, Civitas, and everyone we work for. We operate with professionalism, even when no one is watching. That is our standard at Canon.

specialFocus.title: Midweek: The Theme Is Showing Up on Location. Keep It Going.
specialFocus.why:
Jacob, midweek, and the message is landing. Since Monday, crews have held for zero, stopped a disconnect over a leaking casing, and got a tag and cones in place before anyone started. That's what “same fight” looks like. Today is about keeping it going.

“We're in the same fight together.”
— Mike Lyons
✓ WHERE WE SAW IT THIS WEEK: say these names
  • Michael Jobe, Brook N-13EN 214H (Mon): pulled up to no tag and no cones, told the person in charge, and had it fixed before work began. Find it, fix it, write it.
  • Bryan Medlin, Crawford pads (Mon): two hold points in one day. Both times Medlin waited for zero, made a plan, and kept going only when it was right.
  • Luis Zarate (Mon): well testing across eight sites, every form complete, every photo from the day.
  • Justin Pack, Hughes #1: nothing to fix Friday through Monday. Hayden Haugh and Trevor McKenzie clean Monday too.
▲ KEEP THE MOMENTUM: three for today
  • Give your stop the credit it earned. If you held or stopped the job, tick utilized and write two lines. The good calls you're making this week deserve to be counted.
  • Keep asking "you good?" It's showing up on location. Make it automatic by Friday.
  • Thanksgiving is eight days out. Plan the drive now: journey plan for the long ones, and text your partner when you're home.
Ten minutes: what's landing (1) · names (3) · momentum (2) · the new hand (3) · send-off (1).
specialFocus.standardLabel: Week 23: Operational Discipline, and Good Habits Are Contagious
standard: What you did Monday and Tuesday is the standard now, not the exception.
Find it, fix it, write it. No tag, no cones? Tell the person in charge, fix it before work starts, and put one line on the form.
A hold point is a strength. Waiting for zero isn't a delay. It's the job done right.
The same briefing on job 500 as job 1, with both partners talking.
Watch your partner the way they watch you. "You good?" costs nothing.
Holiday roads: phone down, journey plan on the long drives, and nobody drives tired.

scenarios.title: The New Hand Is Watching
scenarios.body: Holiday coverage puts a newer hand on your crew today. They don't know you, and they're quiet. They'll watch what you do more than they'll listen to what you say. They'll see you do the mask check, ask your partner "you good?", hold for zero, and write the form before you leave the location. Whatever you do today is what they'll do next week when nobody's watching them. Jacob, ask the circle: who taught you a good habit just by doing it in front of you?

questions: What's one thing you saw a teammate do this week that you want to copy?
Who taught you a habit by example, and who are you passing it on to?
What's your plan to get home for Thanksgiving, and who knows it?
specialFocus.nonNegotiable: Keep doing the small things: "you good?", hold for zero, and tick "utilized" when you stop. Same fight, same team. We all go home for the holidays.
